description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single hybrid attacks (0.53 or 198.00 each), grants [Physical Blink 1] to all allies, grants [Awoken Ninja], [Damage Cap +10000], [Ninja Instant Cast (15s)] and [Tri-Element Mode II (Fire, Lightning, Water)] to the user

description.name: Physical Blink 1
description.text: Evades the next PHY attack that deals physical, missing HP or fixed damage or NAT attack that deals physical or fractional damage

description.name: Awoken Ninja
description.text: Ninja abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ninja abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Ninja Instant Cast (15s)
description.text: Instant cast speed for Ninja abilities

description.name: Tri-Element Mode II (Fire, Lightning, Water)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking]/[Attach Water with Stacking] after using a Fire/Lightning/Water ability
